endpoint: Locate the two constructed reference strict classes in ordinary ideal-class two-torsion relative to the six generic strict controls. Distinguish class information from unit information without exceptional points.

bounds.reduction_directions: [0,a,b] with a,b from -4 through4, with [0,0,0] first

method: Construct square-root ideals from the exact projected-atom valuations and generic gcd ideals, correcting only at the complete bad set. Reduce products incrementally with exact principal-multiplier checks. Evaluate the ten generic ordinary unramified characters and two constructed strict characters on cyclic odd-norm ideal representatives by factorwise Jacobi symbols. No class-group completion or prospective class selector is changed.
failure_semantics: If no declared reduced representative has a cyclic residue ring and all character factors invertible, keep that Artin column UNKNOWN. Artin zero does not prove a principal ideal or divisibility. This is not a Cassels-Tate pairing.
inputs: Frozen generic equation projection, certified generic-only unramified masks, certified constructed classes and their exact factors. No exceptional point or historical point-derived anchor.
classification: Incidence: individually constructed strict classes and their ordinary half-ideal images. No rational-solubility or visibility claim.
